coverImageAlt: Cutaway model of interconnected navy and cyan rooms joined by an orange alignment beam.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: a cutaway architectural model of an organization, where distinct rooms for goals, capabilities, processes, people, and information interlock into one coherent structure
Scene/backdrop: warm paper drafting surface with a quiet slate horizon and generous uncluttered space
Subject: one compact open-sided building model made of linked navy and cyan rooms, joined by clear passages, with a single sparing orange alignment beam through the whole structure
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with dimensional paper, painted wood, and architectural-model detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered three-quarter cutaway; one strong building silhouette; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical, restrained soft backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: toothy paper, matte painted wood, subtle graphite-free drafting texture, soft cast shadows
Constraints: all surfaces completely blank and unmarked; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, screens, dashboards, repeated card grids, generic office stock scenes, decorative clutter
